properties.name: ydsz.sentry.enabled
properties.description: 是否启用 Sentry 监控模块。

properties.name: ydsz.sentry.app-name
properties.description: 应用名称，用于日志和指标标识。

properties.name: ydsz.sentry.hostname
properties.description: 主机名，auto 表示自动探测。

properties.name: ydsz.sentry.profile
properties.description: 环境标识（dev/sit/uat/prod）。

properties.name: ydsz.sentry.metrics.primary
properties.description: 主指标采集器：micrometer 或 memory。

properties.name: ydsz.sentry.metrics.enable-system-metrics
properties.description: 是否启用系统资源指标采集。

properties.name: ydsz.sentry.metrics.system-metrics-interval-seconds
properties.description: 系统资源指标采集间隔（秒）。

properties.name: ydsz.sentry.metrics.circuit-breaker.enabled
properties.description: 是否启用指标采集熔断器。

properties.name: ydsz.sentry.metrics.circuit-breaker.failure-rate-threshold
properties.description: 熔断器失败率阈值（0.0~1.0）。

properties.name: ydsz.sentry.metrics.circuit-breaker.sliding-window-size
properties.description: 熔断器滑动窗口大小。

properties.name: ydsz.sentry.metrics.circuit-breaker.half-open-after-seconds
properties.description: 熔断器半开恢复时间（秒）。

properties.name: ydsz.sentry.logging.primary
properties.description: 主日志方案：elk、loki 或 dual。

properties.name: ydsz.sentry.logging.elk.enabled
properties.description: 是否启用 ELK 日志发布器。

properties.name: ydsz.sentry.logging.elk.host
properties.description: Logstash 主机地址。

properties.name: ydsz.sentry.logging.elk.port
properties.description: Logstash 端口。

properties.name: ydsz.sentry.logging.elk.protocol
properties.description: ELK 传输协议：tcp 或 udp。

properties.name: ydsz.sentry.logging.elk.connect-timeout-millis
properties.description: ELK 连接超时（毫秒）。

properties.name: ydsz.sentry.logging.elk.read-timeout-millis
properties.description: ELK 读取超时（毫秒）。

properties.name: ydsz.sentry.logging.elk.max-retry-attempts
properties.description: ELK 最大重试次数。

properties.name: ydsz.sentry.logging.elk.circuit-breaker-threshold
properties.description: ELK 熔断器连续失败阈值。

properties.name: ydsz.sentry.logging.loki.enabled
properties.description: 是否启用 Loki 日志发布器。

properties.name: ydsz.sentry.logging.loki.url
properties.description: Loki 推送 URL。

properties.name: ydsz.sentry.logging.loki.connect-timeout-seconds
properties.description: Loki 连接超时（秒）。

properties.name: ydsz.sentry.logging.loki.max-retry-attempts
properties.description: Loki 最大重试次数。

properties.name: ydsz.sentry.logging.loki.circuit-breaker-threshold
properties.description: Loki 熔断器连续失败阈值。

properties.name: ydsz.sentry.logging.dual.fail-on-all-error
properties.description: 双发模式下所有发布器都失败才算失败。

properties.name: ydsz.sentry.logging.async.enabled
properties.description: 是否启用异步日志发布。

properties.name: ydsz.sentry.logging.async.queue-capacity
properties.description: 异步日志队列容量。

properties.name: ydsz.sentry.logging.async.batch-size
properties.description: 异步日志批量发送大小。

properties.name: ydsz.sentry.logging.async.flush-interval-millis
properties.description: 异步日志刷新间隔（毫秒）。

properties.name: ydsz.sentry.logging.async.max-rate-per-second
properties.description: 异步日志令牌桶限流（每秒最大发送量，0 表示不限流）。

properties.name: ydsz.sentry.tracing.primary
properties.description: 主追踪系统：skywalking、opentelemetry 或 default。

properties.name: ydsz.sentry.tracing.slow-trace-threshold-millis
properties.description: 慢追踪阈值（毫秒）。

properties.name: ydsz.sentry.alerting.enabled
properties.description: 是否启用告警。

properties.name: ydsz.sentry.alerting.silence-period-millis
properties.description: 告警静默期（毫秒）。

properties.name: ydsz.sentry.alerting.log-alerts
properties.description: 是否记录告警日志。

properties.name: ydsz.sentry.alerting.dingtalk-receiver
properties.description: 钉钉告警接收者（webhook 地址或群 ID）。

properties.name: ydsz.sentry.alerting.email-receiver
properties.description: 邮件告警接收者地址。

properties.name: ydsz.sentry.sla.enabled
properties.description: 是否启用 SLA 框架。
